description: Race column stores ethnicity as a categorical string. All 30 records are non‑null with 6 distinct values. Observed case inconsistencies include 'MALAY'/'malay' versus 'Malay' and 'indian' versus 'Indian'; value lengths range from 5 to 7 characters.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert case variations to title case: 'MALAY' → 'Malay', 'malay' → 'Malay', 'indian' → 'Indian'.
[CLARIFY] Confirm the official set of race categories and whether any additional standardization (e.g., handling of spelling variants) is required.
